about: Calibration of TIRust's method-choice acceptance against a target accuracy (m-lit F3 (a), lit-tirust-default): max_ratio is the largest true relative error over the frame deviation the acceptance compares (deviation between a method-choice lane's two frames relative to its term scale; for a point, its largest such lane ratio), each against a consistent truth; v2_tir::UNDERSTATEMENT is the largest, rounded up to two significant digits. Records in the package scratch (workspace/tmp/lit-tir-mp/mc3/evidence.json, workspace/tmp/lit-tirust-default/calib/out/*.json) and m-lit/lit-tirust-default-report.md.

sources.name: synthetic method-choice lanes (lit-tir-mp mc3: refused at 2^-30 by the rescaled check, served by a rotated one; error against NinjaRS at 60 digits)

loop-induced stream rows, |A_loop|^2 finite part per point admitted above 2^-30 (error against TIRust at 256 bits with supplied invariants; the point's admission ratio bracketed by an acceptance ladder, max_ratio = error / the bracket's lower end, an upper bound)
